item.title: Sydney Metro to run 24-hour trains for first time outside of NYE
item.description: Parade-goers can hop on a metro train every 5–10 minutes from 5pm to 2am, then every 20 minutes until 5am. Image: Sydney Metro Sydney Metro will be running a 24-hour service for the first time ever outside of New Year’s Eve, to celebrate the 2026 Sydney Gay & Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade. Extended transport services have been scheduled to keep Sydney moving all day and all night this Saturday February 28.
